intro.text: Make sure you ahve a headset or speakers and that your audio settings are correct.To check the audio settings, do the following: » If you have speakers, make sure that theya re turned on and that the volume is turned up » On the Windows system toolbar(typically located at the bottom of the screen) there is a volume icon in the system tray. Double click on it and make sure that your Windows system volume is turned up and is not muted. » If you are still unable to hear the audio, contact your training specialist or local IT support.
